annotations.title: Show the local cache location, schema and per-user coverage

description: Diagnostics for the LOCAL check-in cache — NO API call. Returns the resolved cache file path, its size on disk (db + WAL), journal mode, schema version, the number of cached menu-line resolutions and beer-metadata rows, and for every cached user: cached vs total distinct beers, cached check-ins, coverage_complete, the resume offset of an unfinished user/beers backfill, and last_synced_at. Use it to confirm the cache persisted across restarts or to see how far a backfill has got.
name: untappd_cache_status
title: Show the local cache location, schema and per-user coverage
